t: You're on New Cavendish Street in Westminster, which runs from Marylebone High Street in the west to Cleveland Street in the east. It was built in 1775 and named after the Cavendish family, who were related to the ground landlords, the Dukes of Portland. One person who lived here was Charles Jocelyn Hambro, who lived from 1897 to 1963. He was a merchant banker and an intelligence officer, and rose to the rank of Air Commodore.
